rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for agreeing with an opinion or approving a proposal.

example.english: I agree with what you said.
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 ji3 nei5 ge3 gong2 faat3

rows.note: Choose this when agreeing to do something or consenting to a request.

example.english: I agree to look after your son tonight.
example.traditional: 我答應你今晚幫你睇住個仔。
example.jyutping: ngo5 daap3 jing3 nei5 gam1 maan5 bong1 nei5 tai2 zyu6 go3 zai2

rows.note: Use this when two things correspond, match, or tally, often negated as 對唔上.

example.english: These two sets of figures agree.
example.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 fan6 sou3 deoi3 dak1 soeng6

rows.note: Use this when something suits or agrees with a person’s body, taste, or constitution, especially food or medicine.

example.english: I agree that this medicine suits my stomach.
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 joek6 gaap3 ngo5 go3 wai6
